description: Add decoding='async' attribute to all img tags in MediaPoster.tsx that lack it, and add fetchPriority attribute for performance. The component at src/components/ui/MediaPoster.tsx currently has loading='lazy' and fetchPriority but is missing decoding='async' which allows the browser to decode images off the main thread.
steps: In src/components/ui/MediaPoster.tsx, add decoding='async' to both img elements (the poster image at ~line 57 and the cat fallback at ~line 68).
acceptance_criteria: Both img elements in MediaPoster.tsx have decoding='async'
